page.content:
France hosts and Zidane wins it on home grass.

How 1998 FIFA World Cup connects

  • Character: Zinedine Zidane — Zidane scored twice in the 1998 World Cup final.
  • Topic: FIFA World Cup — The 1998 tournament is Zidane's home World Cup.
  • Character: Ronaldo — Ronaldo started the 1998 final after a pre-match collapse.

What is 1998 FIFA World Cup?

The 1998 World Cup in France ended with Zidane's two headers against Brazil at the Stade de France, the host's first title.
